Mayawati's Nephew Akash Anand Seeks Forgiveness After BSP Expulsion

Akash Anand, nephew of Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP) leader Mayawati, has broken his silence after being expelled from the party. Anand posted an emotional message addressed to Mayawati, referring to her as his "political guru" and apologizing for his "silence" which he felt was "misunderstood." He also expressed his desire to serve the BSP again, stating that the party is like a "family" to him and dismissing speculation about joining other political parties.
